events.Title: EGM
events.Description:
We have a few committee positions open and we're holding an EGM to fill them.
If you've been thinking about getting more involved with CompSoc, this is the easiest way in. You don't need any experience, just an interest in helping run things. Positions open: Junior SysAdmin, SysAdmin, OCMs, H&S, First Year Rep, Postgrad Rep
Come along even if you're not running. It's a good chance to hear what we have planned for the year and put your ideas forward.
